record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, change each NextItNet block's residual update from residual+y to residual+0.5*y. Scaling convolutional updates may stabilize the six-block stack and preserve useful input information without removing causal convolutions. Keep block count, dilation schedule, features, embeddings, sequence readout, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed. Train one model per category; ensure the predictor writer loads the same residual-scaled architecture and records compatible metadata.
